full_judgment: 2. On 5-5-1985 the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 433 of 1985 in the Third Court of Subordinate Judge in Dhaka against the defendants for a decree of several declarations, namely, that he has got title in Schedule-A property of the plaint to the extent of 1/3rd share; that the suit property is not abandoned property; that judgment and decree dated 29-9-1983 passed in Title Suit No. 566 of 1981 by the Third Court of Subordinate Judge in Dhaka are null and void and that the deeds described in Schedule B to the plaint are equally null and void, and also for a money decree of Taka 3,00,000 against defendant Nos. 3 to 5.
